recap.text: A trap Carl left after the bugbear settlement has killed a hunter. The explosive device, set on a well-travelled path, earns him the achievement Insurgent, a gold Hunter Killer Box and a Gold Trapmaster Box. The first holds 35,000 gold and a hand. The second holds twenty trap add-ons called Fail Safes, which notify him when a trap is disabled or set off.

beats.headline: A trap-leaving reward
beats.text: A sudden group of notifications: a trap Carl left has killed a hunter, a gold Hunter Killer Box, and the achievement Insurgent, for an explosive device left along a well-travelled path that killed its intended target. Too bad he didn't get to see it, because he is a trap-leaving bitch. The reward is a Gold Trapmaster Box. He cannot believe it worked; he placed that one after the bugbear settlement. The hunter-killer box holds 35,000 gold and a hand. The Trapmaster box holds a very useful mod, a pack of twenty trap add-ons called Fail Safes, which will send him a notification if a trap is ever disabled or set off.
beats.gist: Carl's trap kills a hunter, earning the Insurgent achievement and a Gold Trapmaster Box of twenty Fail Safes.
